outcome: Newborn intelligence development (Wechsler preschool intelligence scale)
Maternal serum HBV DNA viral load
cohort: The study included 87 chronic hepatitis B (CHB) women with high viral load during pregnancy and their newborns.
finding: Telbivudine effectively reduced viral load in CHB mothers and lowered the perinatal transmission rate of HBV without adverse effects on the mental and physical development of newborns up to 6 years of age.
mod_finding: No statistical differences were observed between the telbivudine and control groups regarding maternal cesarean section rate.
